description: This header file defines the `Notification` class in the Abseil synchronization library, providing thread notification mechanisms such as wait and notify functions, with internal state management and thread safety considerations.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A class providing thread notification capabilities, allowing threads to wait for and signal a single event.

methods.name: HasBeenNotified
methods.description: Returns whether the notification has been triggered.

methods.name: WaitForNotification
methods.description: Blocks until the notification is triggered.

methods.name: WaitForNotificationWithTimeout
methods.description: Blocks until the notification is triggered or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForNotificationWithDeadline
methods.description: Blocks until the notification is triggered or deadline passes.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Sets the notification as triggered and wakes waiting threads.
